title: Ruby Robin and the First Song
description: A young bird overcomes stage fright to sing her very first morning song to the forest.
character_reference: a plump fluffy bird with rust-red chest feathers and bright intelligent black eyes

scenes.narration: The morning sun was rising, and all the forest birds were tuning up their voices.
scenes.visual: perched on a thin blossoming branch, looking out at a pink dawn sky, feathers fluffed against the morning chill

scenes.narration: It was Ruby's turn to sing the sunrise melody, but her throat felt terribly dry and tight.
scenes.visual: clutching branch tightly with tiny claws, nervous wide eyes, beak clamped shut in worry, soft misty sunrise background

scenes.narration: She hid her head under her wing, wishing she could just disappear into the leaves.
scenes.visual: tucking head completely beneath wing feathers, huddled posture on branch, dejected and shy mood

scenes.narration: An old wise owl nearby winked gently and told her that every voice is special.
scenes.visual: turning head to look at a gentle feathered mentor on a higher branch, reassuring friendly expression

scenes.narration: Ruby took a deep breath, puffed out her red chest, and opened her beak wide.
scenes.visual: inspirational pose inhaling deeply with closed eyes, puffed-out chest feathers, golden morning rays hitting plumage

scenes.narration: A clear, beautiful tune rang out through the trees, filling the quiet woods with music.
scenes.visual: singing with beak wide open toward the sky, joyful expression, musical notes floating in soft morning air

scenes.narration: All the forest animals cheered for her wonderful song, making her heart glow with pride.
scenes.visual: happy proud posture looking down with a cheerful chirp, glowing warm sunlight, serene woodland backdrop

scenes.narration: Your voice matters just the way it is. Follow along for more bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: bowing politely with folded wings, gentle smiling beak, sparkling morning dew drops on leaves
